source: arXiv:2507.03748 TeX (prl_draft.tex) and arXiv:2310.15032 sec. 4, fetched 2026-11-20

C1_sign_rule.rule: w_net = -1 + beta; beta = 2 (abelian, linear Delta H ~ F) gives +1; beta = 0 (su(N), Tr F = 0) gives -1 [D]
C1_sign_rule.consistency_with_B4: PHASE3_WALL_GHOST_COUPLED B4: wall bending alone leaves wall-localized stress at Phi = +4 pi G4 rho/k^2 (repulsive). That is the -1 the paper starts from; 2310.15032 sec. 4 states the same (brane matter negative, overcompensated by H-field backreaction) [D]+[C]

C2_proton.verdict: The O(1) deviation is robust: it needs only that gluons carry O(1/2) of the proton's rest energy, which holds at hadronic scales and at the ~11 TeV string scale of 2311.14589 (RG fixed point A_g ~ 0.47-0.52). The exact 0.009 is not robust (scheme dependent; cbar omitted; central value consistent with zero or negative).
C2_proton.mass_origin_link: Most proton mass is QCD (quark motion + gluon field + trace anomaly), not Yukawa. The sign rule splits exactly along that decomposition, which is why the effect is O(1) and not O(1%).

C3_electroweak.W_Z_at_rest: time-averaged field-strength energy = mass-term energy; -T_SU(2) + T_Higgs gives m_grav = 0, m_inert = m [D]
C3_electroweak.paper_claim_checked: 2507.03748 sec. 3 diagonalises only the Higgs mass matrix (the inertial spectrum) and concludes m_grav = m_inert for W, Z. Its own sign rule gives m_grav(W, Z) = 0 at tree level. [D]
C3_electroweak.photon_weight_under_paper_rule: cos(2 theta_W) = 0.5376, not 1 [D] (unless U(1)_em is the brane trace U(1); model dependent)
C3_electroweak.impact: Does not rescue the model. W, Z are unstable and irrelevant to WEP tests; it shows the EW section is incomplete.

C4_active_passive.passive_mass: Brane fields couple minimally to the induced metric h_ab and follow its geodesics, so free fall is universal: the rule does not by itself violate passive WEP (MICROSCOPE tests passive mass). [D]
C4_active_passive.active_mass: The rule changes the SOURCE T^{00}: active/inertial mass becomes composition dependent. [D]
C4_active_passive.paper_bounds_critique: 2507.03748 uses MICROSCOPE (passive) and an Si-28/Avogadro comparison. Both compare baryonic matter with baryonic matter or test free fall, so a universal baryon factor cancels or does not enter; a universal factor would be absorbed into G4. The decisive test is active-mass composition dependence. [D]
C4_active_passive.verdict: Nuclear Coulomb energy (abelian, weight +1) against QCD binding (weight ~0) makes Al and Fe differ in active mass by eta >= 1e-2 over the whole LQCD band and either electron sign, about 11 orders above LLR. The paper's conclusion survives, through the active-mass channel it did not use. [D]

C5_single_metric.note: Minimal coupling of every sector to one metric g (Res-Nova seat; disformal coupling [X] RN-GEA-RETIRED-001) gives T^{mu nu}_total with unit weight per sector: m_active = m_passive = m_inertial identically. [D]

implications.phase2_matter_sector_scope: PHASE2_MATTER_SECTOR's +G4 result is for stretched-string endpoints (dust of mass tau/k). SM baryons are not stretched strings: under 2507.03748 about half their rest energy (gluons) gravitates with -1. The [D] status holds for string-endpoint dust only.
implications.envelope_embedding: The drag_gcosmo / bulk5d envelope treats baryons and CDM as +G4 fluids. Inside the dark-bubble embedding as currently formulated, baryons have m_g/m_i ~ 0 +- 0.04 (or ~0.06 at the string scale). The cosmological embedding is inconsistent with its own matter coupling unless a new mechanism (not B, C2 fields) couples gluons to induced gravity with weight +1.
implications.drag_seat: The drag condensate is meant to sit in the -G4 seat (B4). That is a feature for a dark component, not a WEP problem, but it does not help the baryon sector.
loopholes_open: [O] A non-B/C mechanism coupling non-abelian fields linearly to a bulk mode (e.g. non-normalizable boundary conditions, 2311.16242).
[O] Quark sign: the paper assumes +1 for quarks without derivation; brane-localized fermions would naively be -1 as well.
[O] Higher-order alpha' terms (Tr F^3, Tr F^4) are subleading and cannot flip the leading sign (paper's argument; not re-derived).

verdict: [D] The paper's conclusion stands and is stronger than stated: O(1) composition-dependent ACTIVE mass, excluded by LLR by about 11 orders. Two corrections to the paper: its tests are the wrong channel (passive / baryon-vs-baryon), and its electroweak section is incomplete (m_grav(W,Z) = 0, photon weight cos 2 theta_W under its own rule). For bulk5d: the dark-bubble embedding cannot carry +G4 baryons as formulated.
